help.title: How to use this app
help.intro: A quick, simple guide for new users. Tap any topic below.

gettingStarted.title: Getting started
gettingStarted.body: After signing up, register your business, factory, or property. Fill in your name, country and contact. The app will set your language and currency automatically — you can change them in Settings anytime.

settings.title: Settings (the most useful page)
settings.body:
Open Settings from the menu. Here you can:
• Change your business code, name, logo, address & contact
• Set the currency symbol (right at the top, below the business code)
• Change the language
• Manage workers, payments, premium and more
Visit Settings once and explore — most app behavior is controlled from here.

🔒 Settings Password (lock the page):
Scroll to "Settings Password" inside Settings. Type a password and tap Save — only you (the boss) will be able to open Settings after that. Leave it empty and Save again to remove the lock.

🆘 Forgot the Settings Password?
On the lock screen, tap the three dots (⋮) in the top-right corner — or the "Forgot password?" link below Unlock. You will be asked for your Business Code (printed on every receipt and shown at the top of Settings). Enter it together with a new password and tap Reset Password. The lock is updated immediately.

discover.title: Discover
discover.body: Discover lets you find other businesses, factories and rentals nearby or worldwide. Use it to send orders, message owners, or book assets. You can also make your own business public so others can find you.

addingItems.title: Adding items to stock
addingItems.body:
Go to Stock and tap "Add Item". Fill in the name, unit, prices and quantity. You can add a photo now or later.

Be patient — adding many items takes time. The good news: you only do it once. If you have workers, they can add items from their own phones after you invite them to your team.

team.title: Team (workers)
team.body: In Team, invite workers using their phone or email. Set their role (Admin or Worker). Workers can sell, add items, record purchases and more from their own phones. This saves you a lot of work.

receipts.title: Receipts, invoices & sharing
receipts.body: Every sale, purchase and service can produce a receipt or invoice. Tap a record to view, share via WhatsApp/SMS, or print. All receipts are saved permanently in Settings → Receipt Archive, even if the original record is deleted.

orders.title: Orders & bargaining
orders.body: Customers can order from you through Discover. You can also order from suppliers the same way. Orders support back-and-forth bargaining: send a price, the other side accepts or counters. Once both agree, the order is confirmed and stock moves automatically.

wasteExpenses.title: Waste & other expenses
wasteExpenses.body: Use Waste to record damaged or lost items — the stock is reduced and the loss is logged as an expense. Use Expenses for other costs like rent, transport or salaries. These keep your profit reports accurate.

multiBusiness.title: Switching & multiple businesses
multiBusiness.body: You can register more than one business, factory or property under the same account. Use the business switcher at the top to move between them. Each one has its own stock, team, sales and reports.

tips.title: Quick tips
tips.body:
• Use the search bar above lists to quickly find a customer or debt
• Use Multi-Delete to clean old records (debts are kept safe)
• Bookmark this Help — open it any time you forget something

audit.title: Business Audit & Accountability
audit.subtitle: Compare the daily cash collected and physical stock against what the app recorded.
audit.startPrompt: Choose the date this audit should start from
audit.startHint: New businesses can start from their first day. Older businesses may pick any date they want to be accountable from.
audit.todayExcluded: Today's records are still changing, so accountability always runs up to yesterday ({{date}}). Today will be included from tomorrow.
audit.noDays: No business days in this period yet.
audit.stockHint: Only items sold in this period are listed. Search to count any other item. Missing items are valued at wholesale price (retail is used when no wholesale price exists).
audit.noteNegative: Money is missing — workers spent or sold without recording. This amount is owed to the business.
audit.notePositive: Extra money is present. Likely unrecorded services, or unrecorded items sold at retail while the audit values missing stock at wholesale. Workers cannot claim this money from the business.
audit.closed: Audit closed and saved. The next period starts from today.
audit.closeHint: The results are saved permanently and the next audit starts where this one ended.
audit.reminderBody: You still have {{count}} day(s) without the total cash collected recorded.
audit.debtsHint: Debts are not cash yet, so they do not change the balance above. They are listed here and on the data sheet so payments can be made and recorded any time.
audit.memoReceivable: Memo: owed to us by customers
audit.memoPayable: Memo: owed by us to suppliers
audit.reminderEncourage: Recording your money every day keeps your accountability clean, shows exactly where losses come from, and helps you grow your profits. It only takes a few seconds — even a day with no business is worth recording as 0.
audit.reminderHint: Enter the total cash collected for each day. Use 0 for days you did not work.
audit.daysRecorded: Daily cash recorded. Thank you for keeping your books accurate!
audit.enterAtLeastOne: Enter the cash for at least one day
audit.freshStart: Start with yesterday and continue from there
audit.freshStartHint: Too many old days to remember? Start clean from yesterday — older days will be left out so your new accountability (and any new workers) start on a clear record.
audit.freshStartDone: Fresh start set. Only yesterday onwards will be tracked from now on.
audit.nudgeWeekTitle: A full week of records saved
audit.nudgeMonthTitle: A full month of records saved
audit.nudgeWeekBody: It has been a week of saving your daily business records. For total accountability, please open Settings → Business Audit and make an accountability for your business, so your records stay organized and your profits keep growing.
audit.nudgeMonthBody: It has been a month of saving your daily business records. For total accountability, please open Settings → Business Audit and make an accountability for your business, so your records stay organized and your profits keep growing.
audit.reminderCapped: To keep it simple, only the last {{count}} day(s) are listed here. Older days can be filled in from the accountability page in Settings.
audit.paperRecordsHint: Have you been writing the daily money in a book or on paper? Open the accountability page and enter all those days there at once.
audit.reminderShowDaily: Show this daily reminder (turn off if you don't want it again)
audit.reminderOffNotice: Daily reminder turned off. Recording your money every day is still important — you can switch the reminder back on any time in Settings → Business Audit & Accountability.
audit.reminderToggleHint: When on, the app reminds you every day to record the cash collected. You can always record it here instead.
audit.reminderOff: Daily reminder turned off. You can still record daily cash here any time.
